# Meilisearch for WordPress & WooCommerce v1.0 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Build and release the official Meilisearch plugin for WordPress + WooCommerce (v1.0): content and product indexing with real-time sync, server-side replacement of theme/WooCommerce search, optional autocomplete, admin, WP-CLI, Site Health, and a wordpress.org release pipeline.

**Architecture:** A single WordPress plugin (`meilisearch`) with a hand-written composition root (`Plugin::build()`) that constructs small single-purpose services and registers their hooks. Meilisearch is reached through our own typed client over `wp_remote_request` (no SDK, no scoping). Two indexes per site (`{prefix}_content`, `{prefix}_products`); a single Indexability rule guarantees only public content is indexed; Action Scheduler runs all background work; full reindexes upsert in place and then sweep orphans (index settings are never copied — embedder keys are redacted by the engine); search is replaced via `posts_pre_query` with strict "translate or don't intercept" rules.

**Tech Stack:** PHP 8.1+, WordPress 6.9+, WooCommerce 8.5+ (optional), Meilisearch 1.34+, Action Scheduler ^4.2 (bundled), PHPUnit 9.6 + yoast/phpunit-polyfills + Brain Monkey (unit), wp-phpunit + roots/wordpress-no-content (integration), Playwright + axe (e2e), Docker Compose (local services, e2e), PHPCS (WPCS 3), PHPStan level 6, `wp plugin check`, GitHub Actions, 10up/action-wordpress-plugin-deploy.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-30-meilisearch-wordpress-plugin-design.md` — read it before starting any task; section numbers (§) below refer to it.

## Global Constraints

- PHP `>=8.1`; Composer `config.platform.php` = `8.1.0`. No PHP 8.2+ syntax: no `readonly class`, no DNF types, no standalone `true`/`false`/`null` types, no `#[\SensitiveParameter]`-only features. Enums and `readonly` promoted properties are allowed.
- WordPress `>=6.9`; readme `Tested up to: 7.1`; WooCommerce `>=8.5` optional; Meilisearch `>=1.34.0` enforced on connect (federated `page`/`hitsPerPage`, documents fetch `filter`/`sort`).
- Runtime dependency: `woocommerce/action-scheduler` `^4.2` only. No Meilisearch SDK, no HTTP client library, no php-scoper/Strauss.
- Action Scheduler is loaded with `require_once` at the top level of `meilisearch.php` (never inside a hook).
- Slug and text domain `meilisearch`; namespace `Meilisearch\WordPress\` (PSR-4 → `src/`); license GPL-2.0-or-later.
- Every PHP file in `src/` starts with `<?php`, `declare(strict_types=1);`, the namespace, then `defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;`.
- Hooks are attached **only** inside `register()` of classes implementing `Registrable`, and every such object is created in `Plugin::build()`.
- All user-facing strings use `__()`/`esc_html__()`/`esc_attr__()` with text domain `meilisearch`; all output escaped; all input sanitized; every admin form uses the Settings API or a nonce; every REST route has a `permission_callback`.
- The admin API key is never printed into HTML and is stored with `autoload = false`.
- Only publicly visible content is indexed (spec § 5.2). Never add status/visibility filters as a substitute for the Indexability rule.
- Index settings: the plugin writes only `filterableAttributes`, `sortableAttributes` (as a union with current values) and `searchableAttributes` (initial / append-only). It never writes `displayedAttributes`, `distinctAttribute`, ranking rules, synonyms, stop words, typo tolerance or embedders.
- Timeouts: search 2 s, writes 15 s, task wait 30 s (admin-synchronous flows only).
- Coding style: WordPress Coding Standards 3 (tabs, spaces inside parentheses, Yoda conditions, snake_case functions/methods/variables) with three exclusions configured in `phpcs.xml.dist`: `WordPress.Files.FileName` (PSR-4 file names), `Universal.Arrays.DisallowShortArraySyntax` (short arrays allowed) and `WordPress.Security.EscapeOutput.ExceptionNotEscaped` (exception messages are not output). File docblocks go before `declare(strict_types=1);`.
- Commit messages: Conventional Commits, no `Co-Authored-By` trailers.

## Review Focus

The five input classes / failure modes the spec implies but that are easiest to miss; each has a pinned test in the named task.

1. **Content that cannot be JSON-encoded** (invalid UTF-8 from legacy imports, binary garbage in meta) → that one post is skipped and logged; the rest of the batch is indexed. Pinned in Task 6 (`ContentDocumentBuilderTest::test_invalid_utf8_is_scrubbed`) and Task 12 (`SyncJobTest::test_unencodable_document_is_skipped_and_logged`).
2. **Hostile or odd search strings** (quotes, backslashes, only whitespace, 5 000-character strings) → never an error page: whitespace-only is not intercepted, `q` is truncated to 500 characters, quotes/backslashes never reach a filter unescaped. Pinned in Task 16 (`QueryTranslatorTest::test_whitespace_query_is_not_intercepted`, `test_long_query_is_truncated`) and Task 15 (`FilterBuilderTest::test_value_escaping`).
3. **Pagination past the end** (`paged=999`) → empty result list, `found_posts` = real total, WordPress renders its normal "no results" template, no PHP warnings. WordPress core answers an empty paged search with a 404 — the plugin must make exactly the same 404 decision as the MySQL path. Pinned in Task 17 (`ResultMapperTest::test_page_beyond_last_returns_empty_but_keeps_totals`) and Task 18 integration (`SearchTest::test_page_beyond_results`).
4. **Host URL variants** (trailing slash, no scheme, reverse-proxy path prefix like `https://example.com/meili/`, uppercase scheme) → normalized consistently; path prefix preserved in every request. Pinned in Task 5 (`OptionsTest::test_host_normalization` data provider) and Task 3 (`ClientTest::test_path_prefix_is_preserved`).
5. **Taxonomy slugs / meta keys with dashes, dots or non-ASCII** (`pa_couleur-é`, `my.key`) → the same normalized field name is used when indexing, when computing settings and when filtering; a name that normalizes to something invalid is skipped everywhere. Pinned in Task 6 (`FieldNameTest`), Task 7 (`SettingsBuilderTest::test_field_names_are_normalized`) and Task 16 (`QueryTranslatorTest::test_meta_key_with_dash_uses_normalized_field`).

## Conventions for every task

- **Unit tests:** `tests/unit/**`, namespace `Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit\…`, extend `Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit\TestCase` (Task 1), which wraps Brain Monkey (`Monkey\setUp()`/`Monkey\tearDown()` in `set_up()`/`tear_down()`) and stubs the translation and escaping functions (`Functions\stubTranslationFunctions()`, `Functions\stubEscapeFunctions()`), and offers `stub_options( array $initial )` (in-memory `get_option`/`update_option`/`add_option`/`delete_option` with `$this->option_store` / `$this->option_autoload`). **Never mock PHP internal functions** (no `function_exists`, `time`, etc. — no Patchwork `redefinable-internals`); inject collaborators or clocks instead. Minimal WordPress class doubles (`WP_Post`, `WP_Query`, `WP_Tax_Query`, `WP_Error`, `WC_Product`-family stubs) live in `tests/unit/Support/wp-doubles.php` and are loaded only if the real class does not exist.
- **Integration tests:** `tests/integration/**`, namespace `Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Integration\…`, extend `Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Integration\TestCase` (Task 2) which gives each test a unique index prefix, a configured connection to the test Meilisearch, `run_actions()` to execute pending Action Scheduler actions synchronously, `wait_for_tasks()` and index cleanup.
- **Commands:** `composer test:unit`, `composer test:integration` (needs `docker compose up -d db meilisearch`), `composer lint`, `composer analyse`, `npm run build`, `npm run test:e2e`.
- **FakeTransport** (`tests/unit/Support/FakeTransport.php`, Task 3): `queue( Response|\Throwable $next ): self`, `respond( int $status, ?array $body = null ): self`, `respond_raw( int $status, string $raw ): self`, `fail( \Throwable $e ): self`, `requests(): list<array{method: string, url: string, headers: array<string,string>, body: mixed, raw_body: ?string, timeout: float}>` (also public `$requests`), `last(): array`, `pending(): int`.
- **Service access in integration tests:** `Plugin::instance()->get( '<service id>' )` (ids in the catalog below).
- Each task ends with its tests passing, `composer lint` clean for touched files, and one commit.

## Interface Catalog (authoritative — every task uses exactly these names and types)

### Core

```php
namespace Meilisearch\WordPress;
interface Registrable { public function register(): void; }

final class Plugin {
	public static function boot(): void;                 // idempotent; build() then register() every Registrable
	public static function instance(): ?Plugin;
	public static function reset(): void;                // tests only: drops the instance (hooks stay attached)
	public function get( string $id ): object;           // throws \OutOfBoundsException for unknown id
	/** @return array<string, object> */
	public function services(): array;
}
```

### Api (`Meilisearch\WordPress\Api`)

```php
final class Response {
	public function __construct( public readonly int $status, public readonly ?array $body, public readonly string $raw ) {}
}
interface Transport {
	/** @param array<string,string> $headers  @throws ApiError code 'transport_error', http_status 0, on network failure/timeout */
	public function send( string $method, string $url, array $headers, ?string $body, float $timeout ): Response;
}
final class WpTransport implements Transport {}           // wp_remote_request; 'timeout' => $timeout, 'redirection' => 0
final class ApiError extends \RuntimeException {
	public function __construct( string $message, public readonly string $error_code, public readonly int $http_status = 0, ?\Throwable $previous = null );
	public static function from_response( Response $response ): self;   // uses body['code'], body['message'] when present
	public static function transport( string $message ): self;          // error_code 'transport_error'
}
final class Client {
	public const SEARCH_TIMEOUT = 2.0;
	public const WRITE_TIMEOUT  = 15.0;
	public function __construct( Transport $transport, string $host, string $api_key, string $user_agent );
	public function version(): array;                                         // GET /version
	public function create_key( array $payload ): array;                      // POST /keys
	public function get_key( string $key_or_uid ): array;                     // GET /keys/{k}
	public function delete_key( string $key_or_uid ): void;                   // DELETE /keys/{k}
	public function index_exists( string $uid ): bool;                        // GET /indexes/{uid}; 404 index_not_found → false
	public function create_index( string $uid, string $primary_key = 'id' ): Task;   // POST /indexes
	public function delete_index( string $uid ): Task;                        // DELETE /indexes/{uid}
	public function list_indexes(): array;                                    // GET /indexes?limit=1000 → results
	public function index_stats( string $uid ): array;                        // GET /indexes/{uid}/stats
	public function get_settings( string $uid ): array;                       // GET /indexes/{uid}/settings
	public function update_settings( string $uid, array $settings ): Task;    // PATCH /indexes/{uid}/settings
	public function add_documents( string $uid, array $documents ): Task;     // POST /indexes/{uid}/documents?primaryKey=id
	public function delete_documents( string $uid, array $ids ): Task;        // POST /indexes/{uid}/documents/delete-batch
	public function delete_all_documents( string $uid ): Task;                // DELETE /indexes/{uid}/documents
	public function fetch_documents( string $uid, array $body ): array;       // POST /indexes/{uid}/documents/fetch → full response {results, offset, limit, total}
	public function get_task( int $task_uid ): array;                         // GET /tasks/{uid}
	public function get_tasks( array $query ): array;                         // GET /tasks?… (list values comma-joined) → full response
	public function search( string $uid, array $params, float $timeout = self::SEARCH_TIMEOUT ): array;          // POST /indexes/{uid}/search
	public function multi_search( array $queries, ?array $federation = null, float $timeout = self::SEARCH_TIMEOUT ): array; // POST /multi-search
}
final class Task {
	public function __construct( private Client $client, public readonly int $uid );
	/** @throws ApiError 'task_failed' (message from task error) | 'task_canceled' | 'task_timeout' */
	public function wait( float $timeout = 30.0, int $poll_ms = 250 ): array;
}
final class ClientFactory {
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options, Transport $transport );   // created and wired in Task 5 (needs Options)
	public function is_configured(): bool;
	/** @throws \RuntimeException 'Meilisearch is not configured.' */
	public function client(): Client;        // cached per md5(host|admin_key); user agent "Meilisearch-WordPress/{MEILISEARCH_VERSION} WordPress/{wp_version}"
}
```

### Settings (`Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings`)

```php
final class Options {
	public const CONNECTION = 'meilisearch_connection';   // host, prefix, search_key, search_key_uid, delete_on_uninstall   (autoload no)
	public const ADMIN_KEY  = 'meilisearch_admin_key';    // string                                                          (autoload no)
	public const CONTENT    = 'meilisearch_content';      // post_types, taxonomies[pt], meta_keys[pt]                       (autoload yes)
	public const WOOCOMMERCE = 'meilisearch_woocommerce'; // enabled, attributes (null = all), custom_attributes, variation_skus (autoload yes)
	public const SEARCH     = 'meilisearch_search';       // replace, highlight, embedder, semantic_ratio, autocomplete      (autoload yes)
	public const STATE      = 'meilisearch_state';        // fingerprint, search_key_manual, needs_reindex[], reindex[], first_reindex_done (autoload no)
	public const LOG        = 'meilisearch_log';          // list of {time, context, message}                                (autoload no)

	/** @return array<string, array<string,mixed>> option name => defaults */
	public static function defaults(): array;                        // @return array<string, mixed>
	/** @param null|callable(string):mixed $constant_reader defaults to fn( $n ) => defined( $n ) ? constant( $n ) : null */
	public function __construct( ?callable $constant_reader = null );
	public static function normalize_host( string $raw ): string;   // see Task 5
	public function seed_defaults(): void;                            // add_option() for missing options with correct autoload
	public function host(): string;                                    // MEILISEARCH_HOST constant wins; normalized
	public function admin_key(): string;                               // MEILISEARCH_ADMIN_KEY constant wins
	public function host_is_constant(): bool;
	public function admin_key_is_constant(): bool;
	public function is_configured(): bool;                             // host !== '' && admin_key !== ''
	public function prefix_override(): string;                         // '' when unset
	public function search_key(): string;
	public function search_key_uid(): string;
	public function save_search_key( string $key, string $uid ): void;
	public function delete_on_uninstall(): bool;
	/** @return list<string> */ public function enabled_post_types(): array;           // never contains 'product'/'product_variation'
	/** @return list<string> */ public function taxonomies_for( string $post_type ): array;
	/** @return list<string> */ public function meta_keys_for( string $post_type ): array;
	/** @return list<string> */ public function all_taxonomies(): array;               // union over enabled post types
	/** @return list<string> */ public function all_meta_keys(): array;
	/** @return array{enabled: bool, attributes: ?list<string>, custom_attributes: bool, variation_skus: bool} */
	public function woocommerce(): array;
	public function products_enabled(): bool;                          // class_exists('WooCommerce') && woocommerce()['enabled']
	/** @return array{replace: bool, highlight: bool, embedder: string, semantic_ratio: float, autocomplete: bool} */
	public function search(): array;
	public function state( string $key, mixed $default_value = null ): mixed;
	public function set_state( string $key, mixed $value ): void;
	public function needs_reindex( string $logical ): bool;
	public function flag_reindex( string $logical, bool $flag ): void;
	public function reindex_state( string $logical ): ?array;
	public function set_reindex_state( string $logical, ?array $state ): void;
}
final class IndexNames {
	public function __construct( Options $options );
	public static function default_prefix( string $home_url, int $blog_id, bool $multisite ): string; // wp_{md5[0..6]} [+ _{blog_id}]
	public function prefix(): string;                         // override or default_prefix( network_home_url()/home_url(), get_current_blog_id(), is_multisite() )
	public function uid( string $logical ): string;           // "{prefix}_{logical}"; logical ∈ {'content','products'}
	/** @return list<string> */ public function active_logicals(): array;  // ['content'] + 'products' when products_enabled()
}
```

Reindex state array shape (stored per logical index): `array{run: string, phase: 'upsert'|'sweep'|'finalizing', last_id: int, sent: int, deleted: int, total: int, task_uids: list<int>, started_at: int, status: 'running'|'failed'|'done', error: string}`. State keys also used: `fingerprint`, `search_key_manual`, `last_connect`, `first_reindex_done`.

### Indexing (`Meilisearch\WordPress\Indexing`)

```php
final class FieldName { public static function normalize( string $raw ): ?string; }   // [^A-Za-z0-9_] → '_', collapse '__', trim '_'; '' → null
interface DocumentBuilder { public function build( \WP_Post $post ): ?array; }        // null = cannot build (skip + log)
interface Schema {
	/** @return list<string> */ public function filterable(): array;
	/** @return list<string> */ public function sortable(): array;
	/** @return list<string> */ public function searchable(): array;   // ordered
}
final class Indexability {
	/** @param null|callable(\WP_Post):bool $product_rule */
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options, $product_rule = null );
	public function index_for_type( string $post_type ): ?string;      // 'products' | 'content' | null (type only)
	public function index_for( \WP_Post $post ): ?string;              // index_for_type( post_type ), null for revisions/autosaves
	public function is_indexable( \WP_Post $post ): bool;              // full § 5.2 rule incl. filter meilisearch_should_index_post
}
final class ContentDocumentBuilder implements DocumentBuilder {
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options );
	public function build( \WP_Post $post ): ?array;                   // core + taxonomy + meta, filter meilisearch_document ($doc, $post, 'content')
	public function core_fields( \WP_Post $post ): array;              // § 5.3 core fields (no taxonomies/meta)
	/** @param list<string> $taxonomies */ public function taxonomy_fields( \WP_Post $post, array $taxonomies ): array;
	/** @param list<string> $keys */       public function meta_fields( int $post_id, array $keys ): array;
	public static function clean_text( string $text ): string;         // wp_check_invalid_utf8( $t, true ), strip tags, collapse whitespace
}
final class ContentSchema implements Schema { public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options ); }
final class SettingsBuilder {
	/** @param array<string, Schema> $schemas logical => schema */
	public function __construct( array $schemas );
	public function has( string $logical ): bool;
	public function initial( string $logical ): array;                 // {searchableAttributes, filterableAttributes, sortableAttributes}, filter meilisearch_index_settings
	public function patch( string $logical, array $current ): array;   // [] when nothing to change; unions filterable/sortable; appends searchable unless ['*']
	/** @return list<string> */ public function missing( string $logical, array $current ): array; // required filterable/sortable not present
}
final class IndexManager {
	public const MIN_VERSION  = '1.34.0';
	public const TASK_TIMEOUT = 30.0;
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\ClientFactory $clients, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\IndexNames $names, SettingsBuilder $settings, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options );
	/** @throws \Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\ApiError | \RuntimeException('unsupported_version') */
	public function check_connection(): string;                        // returns pkgVersion
	/** @return array{version: string, key: 'created'|'kept'|'manual'} */
	public function connect(): array;                                  // § 7.3 steps 2–5
	public function ensure_index( string $logical, ?string $uid = null ): void;   // create if missing (wait) + sync settings (wait)
	public function ensure_all(): void;                                // ensure_index for active_logicals()
	public function sync_settings( string $logical, string $uid ): ?\Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\Task;
	public function verify_search_key( string $key ): ?bool;          // true/false when GET /keys/{key} is allowed, null when it cannot be verified
	/** @return list<string> */ public function drift( string $logical ): array;
	public function rotate_search_key(): string;                       // 'created' | 'manual' (403) ; deletes previous plugin key
}
final class Reindexer implements \Meilisearch\WordPress\Registrable {
	public const DEFAULT_BATCH = 200;
	/** @param array<string, DocumentBuilder> $builders */
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\ClientFactory $clients, IndexManager $indexes, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\IndexNames $names, Indexability $indexability, array $builders, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Sync\Queue $queue, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Sync\ErrorLog $log );
	public function register(): void;                                  // add_action( Queue::REINDEX_BATCH, [ $this, 'handle_batch' ], 10, 1 )
	/** @throws \RuntimeException 'already_running' */
	public function start( string $logical ): array;                   // ensure_index, store state (phase upsert), schedule first batch
	public function handle_batch( array $payload ): void;              // payload {logical, run}; one upsert batch or one sweep page per call, then finalize
	/** @param callable(int $sent, int $total):void $progress */
	public function run_sync( string $logical, int $batch_size, callable $progress ): void;  // CLI path, same steps inline
	public function status( string $logical ): ?array;                 // reindex_state
	/** @param list<int> $ids  @return list<int> ids that are NOT indexable (or no longer exist) */
	public function non_indexable( string $logical, array $ids ): array;
	/** @return list<int> */ public function indexable_ids_after( string $logical, int $last_id, int $limit ): array;
	public function count_indexable( string $logical ): int;
}
```

### Sync (`Meilisearch\WordPress\Sync`)

```php
final class Queue {
	public const GROUP         = 'meilisearch';
	public const SYNC_POSTS    = 'meilisearch_sync_posts';
	public const SYNC_TERM     = 'meilisearch_sync_term';
	public const REINDEX_BATCH = 'meilisearch_reindex_batch';
	public function schedule( string $hook, array $payload, int $delay = 0 ): int;   // as_schedule_single_action( time() + $delay, $hook, array( $payload ), self::GROUP )
	public function cancel_all(): void;                                               // as_unschedule_all_actions( '', array(), self::GROUP )
	public function count( string $status ): int;                                     // 'pending' | 'failed', capped at 1000
}
final class ErrorLog {                      // created in Task 9 (Notices needs it); Task 11 does not recreate it
	public const MAX = 50;
	public function add( string $context, string $message ): void;     // prepends; trims to MAX; error_log() when WP_DEBUG
	/** @return list<array{time: int, context: string, message: string}> */ public function all(): array;
	public function clear(): void;
}
final class ChangeCollector implements \Meilisearch\WordPress\Registrable {
	public const CHUNK = 100;
	public const DELAY = 5;
	public const PENDING_TTL = 60;
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Indexing\Indexability $indexability, Queue $queue, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options );
	public function register(): void;          // § 6.1 hooks + shutdown → flush()
	public function add( int $post_id ): void;
	/** @param list<int> $post_ids */ public function add_many( array $post_ids ): void;
	/** @return array<string, list<int>> */ public function pending(): array;
	public function flush(): void;             // schedules Queue::SYNC_POSTS {index, ids, attempt: 1}; sets transient meilisearch_pending_{blog}_{id}
	public static function clear_pending( array $post_ids ): void;   // deletes those transients (called by SyncJob before reading posts)
}
final class SyncJob implements \Meilisearch\WordPress\Registrable {
	public const BACKOFF      = array( 60, 300, 1800, 7200, 21600 );   // delays before attempts 2..6
	public const MAX_ATTEMPTS = 6;                                     // attempt 6 failing → ErrorLog + rethrow
	/** @param array<string, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Indexing\DocumentBuilder> $builders */
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\ClientFactory $clients, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\IndexNames $names, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Indexing\Indexability $indexability, array $builders, Queue $queue, ErrorLog $log );
	public function register(): void;          // add_action( Queue::SYNC_POSTS, [ $this, 'handle' ], 10, 1 )
	public function handle( array $payload ): void;   // {index, ids, attempt}; retries per BACKOFF, throws after MAX_ATTEMPTS
	/** @param list<int> $ids  @return array{upserted: int, deleted: int, skipped: int} */
	public function reconcile( string $logical, array $ids ): array;  // writes to the live uid only
}
final class TermJob implements \Meilisearch\WordPress\Registrable {
	public const PAGE = 500;
	public function __construct( ChangeCollector $collector, Queue $queue, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options );
	public function register(): void;          // edited_term → schedule SYNC_TERM; delete_term → collector->add_many($object_ids); add_action(SYNC_TERM, handle, 10, 1)
	public function handle( array $payload ): void;   // {taxonomy, term_id, page}
}
```

### Search (`Meilisearch\WordPress\Search`)

```php
final class FilterBuilder {   // pure static helpers; field() throws \InvalidArgumentException on invalid names
	public static function field( string $name ): string;          // ^[A-Za-z0-9_.]+$
	public static function value( string|int|float|bool $value ): string;
	public static function compare( string $field, string $operator, string|int|float|bool $value ): string;  // = != < <= > >=
	/** @param list<string|int|float> $values */ public static function in( string $field, array $values ): string;
	/** @param list<string|int|float> $values */ public static function not_in( string $field, array $values ): string;
	public static function between( string $field, int|float $low, int|float $high ): string;   // "f low TO high"
	public static function exists( string $field ): string;
	public static function not_exists( string $field ): string;
	/** @param list<string> $parts */ public static function all( array $parts ): string;       // AND, parenthesized, empty parts dropped, '' when none
	/** @param list<string> $parts */ public static function any( array $parts ): string;       // OR
	public static function negate( string $expression ): string;                               // "NOT (…)"
	public static function is_empty( string $field ): string;                                  // "f IS EMPTY"
}
final class SearchRequest {
	/**
	 * @param list<string> $logicals  indexes to query ('content', 'products')
	 * @param array<string, list<string>> $filters  logical => expressions (ANDed)
	 * @param array<string, list<string>> $sort     logical => sort rules
	 */
	public function __construct(
		public readonly array $logicals, public readonly string $q, public readonly int $page, public readonly int $hits_per_page,
		public readonly array $filters, public readonly array $sort, public readonly ?array $hybrid, public readonly bool $highlight
	) {}
}
interface ProductTranslator {
	/** @return array{filters: list<string>, sort: list<string>}|null  null = cannot translate → do not intercept */
	public function constraints( \WP_Query $query ): ?array;
}
final class QueryTranslator {
	public const MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 500;
	public const MAX_HITS_PER_PAGE = 1000;
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Indexing\Indexability $indexability, ?ProductTranslator $products = null );
	public function translate( \WP_Query $query ): ?SearchRequest;
}
final class SearchResult {
	/** @param list<int> $ids  @param array<int, array<string,mixed>> $formatted post id => _formatted */
	public function __construct( public readonly array $ids, public readonly int $total_hits, public readonly int $total_pages, public readonly array $formatted ) {}
}
final class Searcher {
	public function __construct( \Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\ClientFactory $clients, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\IndexNames $names );
	public function execute( SearchRequest $request ): SearchResult;   // throws ApiError
}
final class ResultMapper {
	/** @return list<\WP_Post> */ public function apply( \WP_Query $query, SearchResult $result ): array;  // primes caches, sets found_posts/max_num_pages
	public function formatted( int $post_id ): ?array;
	public function reset(): void;
}
final class CircuitBreaker {
	public const TRANSIENT = 'meilisearch_circuit_open';
	public const TTL = 60;
	public function is_open(): bool;
	public function trip(): void;
}
final class Interceptor implements \Meilisearch\WordPress\Registrable {
	public const QUERY_FLAG = 'meilisearch_intercept';   // query var set by pre_get_posts
	public function __construct( QueryTranslator $translator, Searcher $searcher, ResultMapper $mapper, CircuitBreaker $breaker, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Sync\ErrorLog $log );
	public function register(): void;                                  // pre_get_posts (priority 20), posts_pre_query (10, 2)
	public function on_pre_get_posts( \WP_Query $query ): void;
	public function on_posts_pre_query( ?array $posts, \WP_Query $query ): ?array;
	public function should_intercept( \WP_Query $query ): bool;
}
final class Highlighter implements \Meilisearch\WordPress\Registrable {
	public function __construct( ResultMapper $mapper, \Meilisearch\WordPress\Settings\Options $options );
	public function register(): void;                                  // get_the_excerpt (20, 2) when highlight enabled
	public function filter_excerpt( string $excerpt, \WP_Post $post ): string;
}
```

### Service ids for `Plugin::get()`

`options`, `names`, `clients`, `error_log`, `indexability`, `settings_builder`, `index_manager`, `queue`, `collector`, `reindexer`, `sync_job`, `term_job`, `translator`, `searcher`, `result_mapper`, `circuit_breaker`, `interceptor`, `highlighter`, `admin_menu`, `admin_notices`, `admin_rest`, `autocomplete`, `wc_compat`, `wc_product_sync`, `site_health`, `privacy`, `site_seeder`. (`StatusTab` is registered through `Menu`, not as its own service.)

### Final composition root (`src/Plugin.php::build()`, reference)

Each task adds only its own lines, at the marked position; when all tasks are done `build()` reads exactly:

```php
private function build(): void {
	// Task 5 — settings.
	$options = new Settings\Options();
	$names   = new Settings\IndexNames( $options );
	$this->add( 'options', $options );
	$this->add( 'names', $names );

	// Task 5 — API client factory (needs Options).
	$clients = new Api\ClientFactory( $options, new Api\WpTransport() );
	$this->add( 'clients', $clients );

	// Task 9 — error log (used by admin notices, sync and search).
	$error_log = new Sync\ErrorLog();
	$this->add( 'error_log', $error_log );

	// Tasks 6-7 (content), Task 20 (products) — indexing model.
	$products_on  = $options->products_enabled();
	$content_docs = new Indexing\ContentDocumentBuilder( $options );
	$schemas      = array( 'content' => new Indexing\ContentSchema( $options ) );
	$builders     = array( 'content' => $content_docs );
	$product_rule = null;
	if ( $products_on ) {
		$product_rule         = new WooCommerce\ProductRule();
		$schemas['products']  = new WooCommerce\ProductSchema( $options );
		$builders['products'] = new WooCommerce\ProductDocumentBuilder( $content_docs, new WooCommerce\CategoryHierarchy(), new WooCommerce\AttributeCollector(), $options );
	}
	$indexability = new Indexing\Indexability( $options, $product_rule );
	$settings     = new Indexing\SettingsBuilder( $schemas );
	$this->add( 'indexability', $indexability );
	$this->add( 'settings_builder', $settings );

	// Task 8 — index manager.
	$indexes = new Indexing\IndexManager( $clients, $names, $settings, $options );
	$this->add( 'index_manager', $indexes );

	// Tasks 11-13 — sync and reindex.
	$queue     = new Sync\Queue();
	$collector = new Sync\ChangeCollector( $indexability, $queue, $options );
	$sync_job  = new Sync\SyncJob( $clients, $names, $indexability, $builders, $queue, $error_log );
	$reindexer = new Indexing\Reindexer( $clients, $indexes, $names, $indexability, $builders, $queue, $options, $error_log );
	$this->add( 'queue', $queue );
	$this->add( 'collector', $collector );
	$this->add( 'reindexer', $reindexer );
	$this->add( 'sync_job', $sync_job );
	$this->add( 'term_job', new Sync\TermJob( $collector, $queue, $options ) );

	// Tasks 15-18, Task 22 — search.
	$product_translator = $products_on ? new WooCommerce\ProductQueryTranslator( $options ) : null;
	$translator         = new Search\QueryTranslator( $options, $indexability, $product_translator );
	$searcher           = new Search\Searcher( $clients, $names );
	$mapper             = new Search\ResultMapper();
	$breaker            = new Search\CircuitBreaker();
	$this->add( 'translator', $translator );
	$this->add( 'searcher', $searcher );
	$this->add( 'result_mapper', $mapper );
	$this->add( 'circuit_breaker', $breaker );
	$this->add( 'interceptor', new Search\Interceptor( $translator, $searcher, $mapper, $breaker, $options, $error_log ) );
	$this->add( 'highlighter', new Search\Highlighter( $mapper, $options ) );

	// Tasks 9-10, 14, 21 — admin.
	$tabs = array(
		new Admin\ConnectionTab( $options, $indexes, $names ),
		new Admin\ContentTab( $options ),
	);
	if ( class_exists( 'WooCommerce' ) ) {
		$tabs[] = new WooCommerce\WooCommerceTab( $options );
	}
	$tabs[] = new Admin\SearchTab( $options );
	$tabs[] = new Admin\StatusTab( $options, $names, $reindexer, $error_log, $clients );
	$this->add( 'admin_menu', new Admin\Menu( $tabs ) );
	$this->add( 'admin_notices', new Admin\Notices( $options, $error_log ) );
	$this->add( 'admin_rest', new Admin\RestController( $indexes, $reindexer, $options ) );

	// Task 19, Task 21 — WooCommerce hooks.
	if ( class_exists( 'WooCommerce' ) ) {
		$this->add( 'wc_compat', new WooCommerce\Compatibility() );
	}
	if ( $products_on ) {
		$this->add( 'wc_product_sync', new WooCommerce\ProductSync( $collector, $options ) );
	}

	// Task 23 — frontend.
	$this->add( 'autocomplete', new Frontend\Autocomplete( $options, $names ) );

	// Tasks 24-26 — operations (24 Site Health + privacy, 25 WP-CLI) and lifecycle (26).
	$health = new Ops\SiteHealth( $clients, $indexes, $names, $reindexer, $queue, $options );
	$this->add( 'site_health', $health );
	$this->add( 'privacy', new Ops\Privacy() );
	$this->add( 'site_seeder', new Lifecycle\SiteSeeder() );
	if ( defined( 'WP_CLI' ) && WP_CLI ) {
		\WP_CLI::add_command( 'meilisearch', new Ops\Cli( $reindexer, $sync_job, $clients, $names, $health, $indexability, $queue ) );
	}
}
```

### Task 1: Scaffolding, bootstrap file, `Plugin`/`Registrable`, unit test harness, lint/static-analysis config

**Files:**
- Create: `composer.json`, `phpunit.xml.dist`, `phpcs.xml.dist`, `phpstan.neon.dist`, `.gitignore`, `.gitattributes`, `LICENSE`
- Create: `meilisearch.php`, `src/Registrable.php`, `src/Plugin.php`
- Create: `tests/unit/bootstrap.php`, `tests/unit/TestCase.php`, `tests/unit/Support/wp-doubles.php`
- Test: `tests/unit/PluginTest.php`, `tests/unit/Support/WpDoublesTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing.
- Produces (catalog):
  - `interface Registrable { public function register(): void; }`
  - `final class Plugin { public static function boot(): void; public static function instance(): ?Plugin; public static function reset(): void; public function get( string $id ): object; public function services(): array; }` plus the private helpers every later task uses inside `build()`: `private function add( string $id, object $service ): void` (throws `\LogicException` on a duplicate id) and `private function build(): void` (empty until Task 5).
  - Constants `MEILISEARCH_VERSION` (`'1.0.0'`), `MEILISEARCH_FILE`, `MEILISEARCH_DIR` (trailing slash).
  - Unit test base class `Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit\TestCase` (see Step 4) with `stub_options( array $initial = array() ): void`, `$option_store`, `$option_autoload`, and default stubs for `wp_parse_url` (→ `parse_url`) and `wp_json_encode` (→ `json_encode`).
  - WordPress/WooCommerce doubles in `tests/unit/Support/wp-doubles.php` (see Step 5): `WP_Post`, `WP_Query`, `WP_Tax_Query`, `WP_Error`, `WC_Product`, `WC_Product_Variable`, `WC_Product_Variation`, `WC_Product_Attribute`.

Notes for the implementer:
- Activation/deactivation hooks are **not** registered in this task; Task 26 adds `register_activation_hook()`/`register_deactivation_hook()` to `meilisearch.php` together with `Lifecycle\Activator`/`Deactivator`. No stub classes are created here.
- `meilisearch.php` is the only file that attaches hooks outside a `Registrable::register()` (the `plugins_loaded` boot hook, spec § 4.1).
- `phpcs.xml.dist` has the three exclusions of the Global Constraints. `WordPress.Security.EscapeOutput.ExceptionNotEscaped` is needed because WPCS 3 treats every `throw new X( $message )` as output; exception messages are data, and every place that displays one escapes it (`esc_html( $e->getMessage() )`). Test files additionally skip the documentation, prefix and "alternative function" sniffs (see the file).
- `phpstan.neon.dist` temporarily ignores `method.unused` for `src/Plugin.php` because the private `Plugin::add()` has no caller until Task 5; Task 5 deletes that entry (PHPStan fails on an unmatched ignore, so it cannot be forgotten).
- `phpcs.xml.dist` and `phpstan.neon.dist` list the analysed paths explicitly (`meilisearch.php`, `src`, `tests`). Task 26 must add `uninstall.php` to both files when it creates it.
- `tests/unit/PluginTest.php` boots the real composition root. `add_action()`/`add_filter()` are provided by Brain Monkey and `get_option()` is stubbed by `stub_options()`. A later task whose `build()` or `register()` code calls any other WordPress function at boot time must add a stub for it to `PluginTest::set_up()`.

```php
/**

 */

declare(strict_types=1);

$meilisearch_root = dirname( __DIR__, 2 );
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Create the unit test base class**

Create `tests/unit/TestCase.php`:

```php
<?php
/**
 * Base class for unit tests.
 *
 * @package Meilisearch
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit;

use Brain\Monkey;
use Brain\Monkey\Functions;
use Mockery\Adapter\Phpunit\MockeryPHPUnitIntegration;
use Yoast\PHPUnitPolyfills\TestCases\TestCase as PolyfillTestCase;

/**
 * Wraps Brain Monkey and provides an in-memory option table.
 */
abstract class TestCase extends PolyfillTestCase {

	use MockeryPHPUnitIntegration;

	/**
	 * Option table backing the stubs installed by stub_options().
	 *
	 * @var array<string, mixed>
	 */
	protected array $option_store = [];

	/**
	 * Autoload flag passed to add_option()/update_option() for each option they wrote.
	 *
	 * @var array<string, mixed>
	 */
	protected array $option_autoload = [];

	protected function set_up(): void {
		parent::set_up();
		Monkey\setUp();
		Functions\stubTranslationFunctions();
		Functions\stubEscapeFunctions();
		// Pure helpers with identical PHP equivalents on PHP 8.1+.
		Functions\when( 'wp_parse_url' )->alias( 'parse_url' );
		Functions\when( 'wp_json_encode' )->alias( 'json_encode' );
		$this->option_store    = [];
		$this->option_autoload = [];
	}

	protected function tear_down(): void {
		Monkey\tearDown();
		parent::tear_down();
	}

	/**
	 * Backs get_option(), add_option(), update_option() and delete_option() with $this->option_store.
	 *
	 * @param array<string, mixed> $initial Option name => value.
	 */
	protected function stub_options( array $initial = [] ): void {
		$this->option_store    = $initial;
		$this->option_autoload = [];

		Functions\when( 'get_option' )->alias(
			function ( string $name, $default_value = false ) {
				return array_key_exists( $name, $this->option_store ) ? $this->option_store[ $name ] : $default_value;
			}
		);
		Functions\when( 'add_option' )->alias(
			function ( string $name, $value = '', $deprecated = '', $autoload = null ): bool {
				if ( array_key_exists( $name, $this->option_store ) ) {
					return false;
				}
				$this->option_store[ $name ]    = $value;
				$this->option_autoload[ $name ] = $autoload;
				return true;
			}
		);
		Functions\when( 'update_option' )->alias(
			function ( string $name, $value, $autoload = null ): bool {
				$this->option_store[ $name ] = $value;
				if ( null !== $autoload ) {
					$this->option_autoload[ $name ] = $autoload;
				}
				return true;
			}
		);
		Functions\when( 'delete_option' )->alias(
			function ( string $name ): bool {
				$existed = array_key_exists( $name, $this->option_store );
				unset( $this->option_store[ $name ] );
				return $existed;
			}
		);
	}
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Create the WordPress/WooCommerce class doubles**

These doubles are shared by every unit test in the plan. They hold state that tests set and mirror the real public API that plugin code calls. Public API (other tasks rely on exactly this):

| Class | Construction | Public API |
|---|---|---|
| `WP_Post` | `new WP_Post( array\|object $fields = array() )` copies each key onto a property | all real `WP_Post` properties with real defaults (`ID` 0, `post_author` '0', `post_status` 'publish', `post_password` '', `post_type` 'post', `post_parent` 0, dates '0000-00-00 00:00:00', `filter` 'raw', …) |
| `WP_Query` | `new WP_Query( array $query_vars = array() )` sets `$query` and `$query_vars`; runs no query | `get( $var, $default_value = '' )` (real `isset` semantics), `set( $var, $value )`, `is_main_query()` returns `$main_query`, `is_search()` returns `$search`; public `$query`, `$query_vars`, `$tax_query` (`?WP_Tax_Query`, null until the test assigns one), `$meta_query` (false), `$date_query` (false), `$posts` (null), `$post_count` (0), `$found_posts` (0), `$max_num_pages` (0), `$main_query` (false), `$search` (false) |
| `WP_Tax_Query` | `new WP_Tax_Query( array $tax_query )` — same normalization as core: `$relation` ('AND'/'OR'), `$queries` with defaults `taxonomy ''`, `terms array()`, `field 'term_id'`, `operator 'IN'`, `include_children true`, nested groups get a `relation` key | public `$queries`, `$relation`, `$queried_terms`; `sanitize_query( array )`, `sanitize_relation( string )` |
| `WP_Error` | `new WP_Error( $code = '', $message = '', $data = '' )` | `add()`, `get_error_codes()`, `get_error_code()`, `get_error_message( $code = '' )`, `get_error_data( $code = '' )`, `has_errors()` |
| `WC_Product` | `new WC_Product( array $props = array() )` | `set_props( array )`; getters reading props with defaults: `get_id()` 0, `get_type()` 'simple', `get_name()` '', `get_sku()` '', `get_parent_id()` 0, `get_status()` 'publish', `is_featured()` false, `get_catalog_visibility()` 'visible', `get_price()` '', `get_regular_price()` '', `get_sale_price()` '', `is_on_sale()` false (prop `on_sale`), `get_stock_status()` 'instock', `is_in_stock()` (`'outofstock' !== get_stock_status()`), `get_stock_quantity()` null, `get_average_rating()` 0.0, `get_rating_count()` 0, `get_total_sales()` 0, `get_children()` array(), `get_attributes()` array(), `get_meta( $key, $single = true )` (prop `meta` is a key => value map), `is_type( string\|array )` |
| `WC_Product_Variable` | extends `WC_Product` | `get_type()` 'variable'; `get_variation_price( $min_or_max = 'min', $for_display = false )` reads prop `variation_prices` (`array( 'min' => …, 'max' => … )`) |
| `WC_Product_Variation` | extends `WC_Product` | `get_type()` 'variation'; `get_variation_attributes( $with_prefix = true )` reads prop `attributes` (`slug => value`) and prefixes keys with `attribute_` like core |
| `WC_Product_Attribute` | `new WC_Product_Attribute()` then real setters | `set_id/set_name/set_options/set_position/set_visible/set_variation`, matching getters, `is_taxonomy()` (`0 < get_id()`). `get_terms()` is not provided: resolve term names with stubbed WordPress/WooCommerce functions. |

Create `tests/unit/Support/wp-doubles.php`:

```php
<?php
/**
 * Minimal doubles of WordPress and WooCommerce classes for unit tests.
 *
 * Each class is declared only when the real one is not loaded. The doubles hold state that tests
 * set and mirror the real public API that plugin code calls; they never query a database.
 *
 * @package Meilisearch
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_Post' ) ) {
	#[\AllowDynamicProperties]
	class WP_Post {
		public $ID                    = 0;
		public $post_author           = '0';
		public $post_date             = '0000-00-00 00:00:00';
		public $post_date_gmt         = '0000-00-00 00:00:00';
		public $post_content          = '';
		public $post_title            = '';
		public $post_excerpt          = '';
		public $post_status           = 'publish';
		public $comment_status        = 'open';
		public $ping_status           = 'open';
		public $post_password         = '';
		public $post_name             = '';
		public $to_ping               = '';
		public $pinged                = '';
		public $post_modified         = '0000-00-00 00:00:00';
		public $post_modified_gmt     = '0000-00-00 00:00:00';
		public $post_content_filtered = '';
		public $post_parent           = 0;
		public $guid                  = '';
		public $menu_order            = 0;
		public $post_type             = 'post';
		public $post_mime_type        = '';
		public $comment_count         = '0';
		public $filter                = 'raw';

		public function __construct( $fields = [] ) {
			foreach ( (array) $fields as $key => $value ) {
				$this->$key = $value;
			}
		}
	}
}

if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_Tax_Query' ) ) {
	class WP_Tax_Query {
		public $queries       = [];
		public $relation      = 'AND';
		public $queried_terms = [];

		public function __construct( $tax_query ) {
			$this->relation = isset( $tax_query['relation'] ) ? $this->sanitize_relation( $tax_query['relation'] ) : 'AND';
			$this->queries  = $this->sanitize_query( $tax_query );
		}

		public function sanitize_query( $queries ) {
			$cleaned  = [];
			$defaults = [
				'taxonomy'         => '',
				'terms'            => [],
				'field'            => 'term_id',
				'operator'         => 'IN',
				'include_children' => true,
			];
			foreach ( $queries as $key => $query ) {
				if ( 'relation' === $key ) {
					$cleaned['relation'] = $this->sanitize_relation( $query );
				} elseif ( self::is_first_order_clause( $query ) ) {
					$clause          = array_merge( $defaults, $query );
					$clause['terms'] = (array) $clause['terms'];
					$cleaned[]       = $clause;
					if ( '' !== $clause['taxonomy'] && 'NOT IN' !== $clause['operator'] && ! isset( $this->queried_terms[ $clause['taxonomy'] ] ) ) {
						$this->queried_terms[ $clause['taxonomy'] ] = [
							'terms' => $clause['terms'],
							'field' => $clause['field'],
						];
					}
				} elseif ( is_array( $query ) ) {
					$sub = $this->sanitize_query( $query );
					if ( [] !== $sub ) {
						if ( ! isset( $sub['relation'] ) ) {
							$sub['relation'] = 'AND';
						}
						$cleaned[] = $sub;
					}
				}
			}
			return $cleaned;
		}

		public function sanitize_relation( $relation ) {
			return 'OR' === strtoupper( (string) $relation ) ? 'OR' : 'AND';
		}

		protected static function is_first_order_clause( $query ) {
			return is_array( $query ) && (
				[] === $query
				|| array_key_exists( 'terms', $query )
				|| array_key_exists( 'taxonomy', $query )
				|| array_key_exists( 'include_children', $query )
				|| array_key_exists( 'field', $query )
				|| array_key_exists( 'operator', $query )
			);
		}
	}
}

if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_Query' ) ) {
	#[\AllowDynamicProperties]
	class WP_Query {
		public $query         = [];
		public $query_vars    = [];
		public $tax_query     = null;
		public $meta_query    = false;
		public $date_query    = false;
		public $posts         = null;
		public $post_count    = 0;
		public $found_posts   = 0;
		public $max_num_pages = 0;
		// Test-only flags returned by is_main_query() and is_search().
		public $main_query = false;
		public $search     = false;

		public function __construct( $query_vars = [] ) {
			$this->query      = $query_vars;
			$this->query_vars = $query_vars;
		}

		public function get( $query_var, $default_value = '' ) {
			if ( isset( $this->query_vars[ $query_var ] ) ) {
				return $this->query_vars[ $query_var ];
			}
			return $default_value;
		}

		public function set( $query_var, $value ) {
			$this->query_vars[ $query_var ] = $value;
		}

		public function is_main_query() {
			return (bool) $this->main_query;
		}

		public function is_search() {
			return (bool) $this->search;
		}
	}
}

if ( ! class_exists( 'WP_Error' ) ) {
	class WP_Error {
		public $errors     = [];
		public $error_data = [];

		public function __construct( $code = '', $message = '', $data = '' ) {
			if ( '' === $code ) {
				return;
			}
			$this->add( $code, $message, $data );
		}

		public function add( $code, $message, $data = '' ) {
			$this->errors[ $code ][] = $message;
			if ( '' !== $data ) {
				$this->error_data[ $code ] = $data;
			}
		}

		public function get_error_codes() {
			return array_keys( $this->errors );
		}

		public function get_error_code() {
			$codes = $this->get_error_codes();
			return [] === $codes ? '' : $codes[0];
		}

		public function get_error_message( $code = '' ) {
			if ( '' === $code ) {
				$code = $this->get_error_code();
			}
			return $this->errors[ $code ][0] ?? '';
		}

		public function get_error_data( $code = '' ) {
			if ( '' === $code ) {
				$code = $this->get_error_code();
			}
			return $this->error_data[ $code ] ?? null;
		}

		public function has_errors() {
			return [] !== $this->errors;
		}
	}
}

if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product' ) ) {
	class WC_Product {
		protected $props = [];

		public function __construct( $props = [] ) {
			$this->set_props( $props );
		}

		public function set_props( $props ) {
			foreach ( $props as $key => $value ) {
				$this->props[ $key ] = $value;
			}
		}

		protected function prop( $key, $default_value ) {
			return array_key_exists( $key, $this->props ) ? $this->props[ $key ] : $default_value;
		}

		public function get_id() {
			return (int) $this->prop( 'id', 0 );
		}

		public function get_type() {
			return $this->prop( 'type', 'simple' );
		}

		public function is_type( $type ) {
			return in_array( $this->get_type(), (array) $type, true );
		}

		public function get_name() {
			return $this->prop( 'name', '' );
		}

		public function get_sku() {
			return $this->prop( 'sku', '' );
		}

		public function get_parent_id() {
			return (int) $this->prop( 'parent_id', 0 );
		}

		public function get_status() {
			return $this->prop( 'status', 'publish' );
		}

		public function is_featured() {
			return (bool) $this->prop( 'featured', false );
		}

		public function get_catalog_visibility() {
			return $this->prop( 'catalog_visibility', 'visible' );
		}

		public function get_price() {
			return $this->prop( 'price', '' );
		}

		public function get_regular_price() {
			return $this->prop( 'regular_price', '' );
		}

		public function get_sale_price() {
			return $this->prop( 'sale_price', '' );
		}

		public function is_on_sale() {
			return (bool) $this->prop( 'on_sale', false );
		}

		public function get_stock_status() {
			return $this->prop( 'stock_status', 'instock' );
		}

		public function is_in_stock() {
			return 'outofstock' !== $this->get_stock_status();
		}

		public function get_stock_quantity() {
			return $this->prop( 'stock_quantity', null );
		}

		public function get_average_rating() {
			return $this->prop( 'average_rating', 0.0 );
		}

		public function get_rating_count() {
			return (int) $this->prop( 'rating_count', 0 );
		}

		public function get_total_sales() {
			return (int) $this->prop( 'total_sales', 0 );
		}

		public function get_children() {
			return $this->prop( 'children', [] );
		}

		public function get_attributes() {
			return $this->prop( 'attributes', [] );
		}

		public function get_meta( $key = '', $single = true ) {
			$meta = $this->prop( 'meta', [] );
			if ( array_key_exists( $key, $meta ) ) {
				return $meta[ $key ];
			}
			return $single ? '' : [];
		}
	}
}

if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product_Variable' ) ) {
	class WC_Product_Variable extends WC_Product {

		public function get_variation_price( $min_or_max = 'min', $for_display = false ) {

if ( ! class_exists( 'WC_Product_Variation' ) ) {
	class WC_Product_Variation extends WC_Product {
		public function get_type() {
			return $this->prop( 'type', 'variation' );
		}

		public function get_variation_attributes( $with_prefix = true ) {
			$attributes = (array) $this->prop( 'attributes', [] );
			if ( ! $with_prefix ) {
				return $attributes;
			}
			$prefixed = [];
			foreach ( $attributes as $slug => $value ) {
				$prefixed[ 'attribute_' . $slug ] = $value;
			}
			return $prefixed;
		}
	}
}

		public function get_variation() {

		}

		public function is_taxonomy() {
			return 0 < $this->get_id();
```

```php
/**

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit;

use Meilisearch\WordPress\Plugin;
use Meilisearch\WordPress\Registrable;

	}

	public function test_boot_is_idempotent(): void {
		Plugin::boot();
		$first = Plugin::instance();
		Plugin::boot();

		$this->assertInstanceOf( Plugin::class, $first );
		$this->assertSame( $first, Plugin::instance() );
	}

	public function test_reset_drops_the_instance(): void {

		Plugin::reset();

		$this->assertNull( Plugin::instance() );

	public function test_get_unknown_id_throws(): void {

		$this->expectException( \OutOfBoundsException::class );
		$this->expectExceptionMessage( 'Unknown Meilisearch service "nope".' );

		Plugin::instance()->get( 'nope' );
	}

	public function test_registrable_services_are_registered_once(): void {
		$spy    = new class() implements Registrable {
			public int $calls = 0;

			public function register(): void {
				++$this->calls;
			}
		};
		$plain  = new \stdClass();
		$plugin = ( new ReflectionClass( Plugin::class ) )->newInstanceWithoutConstructor();

		$this->call_private( $plugin, 'add', 'spy', $spy );
		$this->call_private( $plugin, 'add', 'plain', $plain );
		$this->call_private( $plugin, 'register_services' );

		$this->assertSame( 1, $spy->calls );
		$this->assertSame( $spy, $plugin->get( 'spy' ) );
		$this->assertSame(
			[
				'spy'   => $spy,
				'plain' => $plain,
			],
			$plugin->services()
		);
	}

	public function test_duplicate_service_id_throws(): void {
		$plugin = ( new ReflectionClass( Plugin::class ) )->newInstanceWithoutConstructor();
		$this->call_private( $plugin, 'add', 'one', new \stdClass() );

		$this->expectException( \LogicException::class );
		$this->expectExceptionMessage( 'Meilisearch service "one" is already registered.' );

		$this->call_private( $plugin, 'add', 'one', new \stdClass() );
	}

	/**
	 * Invokes a private method (PHP 8.1+ reflection needs no setAccessible()).
	 *
	 * @param object $target Object.
	 * @param string $method Method name.
	 * @param mixed  ...$args Arguments.
	 * @return mixed
	 */
	private function call_private( object $target, string $method, ...$args ) {
		return ( new ReflectionMethod( $target, $method ) )->invoke( $target, ...$args );
	}
}
```

```php
			]

		$this->assertSame( 'page', $post->post_type );
		$this->assertSame( 'publish', $post->post_status );
		$this->assertSame( '', $post->post_password );

			]
		);
		$query->set( 'posts_per_page', 5 );
		$query->main_query = true;

		$this->assertSame( 'shoes', $query->get( 's' ) );
		$this->assertSame( 1, $query->get( 'paged', 1 ) );
		$this->assertSame( 5, $query->get( 'posts_per_page' ) );
		$this->assertSame( '', $query->get( 'missing' ) );
		$this->assertTrue( $query->is_main_query() );
		$this->assertFalse( $query->is_search() );
		$this->assertNull( $query->tax_query );
	}

				],
				[

						'field'    => 'slug',
						'terms'    => [ 'a', 'b' ],

					],

		);

		$this->assertSame( 'OR', $tax_query->relation );

					'field'            => 'term_id',

				[

						'field'            => 'slug',
						'operator'         => 'NOT IN',
						'include_children' => true,
					],
					'relation' => 'AND',
				],
```

Create `src/Registrable.php`:

```php
<?php
/**
 * Contract for services that attach WordPress hooks.
 *
 * @package Meilisearch
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Meilisearch\WordPress;

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * A service whose actions and filters are attached in register().
 */
interface Registrable {

	/**
	 * Attaches the service's actions and filters.
	 */
	public function register(): void;
}
```

Create `src/Plugin.php`:

```php
<?php
/**
 * Composition root.
 *
 * @package Meilisearch
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Meilisearch\WordPress;

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Builds every service by hand and registers the hooks of each Registrable service.
 */
final class Plugin {

	/**
	 * The booted instance; null before boot() and after reset().
	 *
	 * @var Plugin|null
	 */
	private static ?Plugin $instance = null;

	/**
	 * Services keyed by id, in construction order.
	 *
	 * @var array<string, object>
	 */
	private array $services = array();

	/**
	 * Use boot().
	 */
	private function __construct() {}

	/**
	 * Builds all services and registers their hooks. Calling it again does nothing.
	 */
	public static function boot(): void {
		if ( null !== self::$instance ) {
			return;
		}
		$plugin = new self();
		$plugin->build();
		self::$instance = $plugin;
		$plugin->register_services();
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the booted instance.
	 *
	 * @return Plugin|null Null before boot().
	 */
	public static function instance(): ?Plugin {
		return self::$instance;
	}

	/**
	 * Drops the instance so the next boot() builds a fresh one. Tests only: hooks stay attached.
	 */
	public static function reset(): void {
		self::$instance = null;
	}

	/**
	 * Returns a service by id.
	 *
	 * @param string $id Service id.
	 * @return object
	 * @throws \OutOfBoundsException When no service has that id.
	 */
	public function get( string $id ): object {
		if ( ! isset( $this->services[ $id ] ) ) {
			throw new \OutOfBoundsException( sprintf( 'Unknown Meilisearch service "%s".', $id ) );
		}
		return $this->services[ $id ];
	}

	/**
	 * Returns every service keyed by id.
	 *
	 * @return array<string, object>
	 */
	public function services(): array {
		return $this->services;
	}

	/**
	 * Stores a service under an id.
	 *
	 * @param string $id      Service id.
	 * @param object $service Service.
	 * @throws \LogicException When the id is already taken.
	 */
	private function add( string $id, object $service ): void {
		if ( isset( $this->services[ $id ] ) ) {
			throw new \LogicException( sprintf( 'Meilisearch service "%s" is already registered.', $id ) );
		}
		$this->services[ $id ] = $service;
	}

	/**
	 * Calls register() on every Registrable service, in construction order.
	 */
	private function register_services(): void {
		foreach ( $this->services as $service ) {
			if ( $service instanceof Registrable ) {
				$service->register();
			}
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Constructs every service.
	 */
	private function build(): void {
		// Services are added here task by task; see "Final composition root" in the plan.
	}
}
```

### Task 2: Local services (`compose.yaml`) and integration test harness

**Files:**
- Create: `compose.yaml`, `phpunit-integration.xml.dist`, `tests/integration/wp-tests-config.php`, `tests/integration/bootstrap.php`, `tests/integration/TestCase.php`
- Modify: `composer.json` (full replacement below)
- Test: `tests/integration/PluginLoadsTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Plugin::instance()` (Task 1); Action Scheduler 4.2 API — `as_schedule_single_action()`, `as_get_scheduled_actions( $args, 'ids' )`, `ActionScheduler::runner()->process_action( int $action_id, string $context )`, `ActionScheduler_Store::STATUS_PENDING`, action `action_scheduler_failed_execution( $action_id, $exception, $context )`.
- Produces: `abstract class Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Integration\TestCase extends \WP_UnitTestCase` with:
  - `protected string $prefix` — unique per test, `test_` + 6 lowercase alphanumerics; the plugin's index uids are `{$prefix}_content` / `{$prefix}_products`.
  - `protected array $action_failures` — `list<string>` of `"{hook}: {message}"` for actions that failed during the last `run_actions()`.
  - `protected function run_actions( int $max_rounds = 20 ): int` — executes every pending action in group `meilisearch` regardless of its scheduled date, repeating while handlers schedule new ones (at most `$max_rounds` passes); returns the number executed.
  - `protected function wait_for_tasks(): void` — polls `GET /tasks?statuses=enqueued,processing&limit=1` until empty (fails the test after 30 s).
  - `protected function meili( string $method, string $path, ?array $body = null ): array` — raw authenticated request to the test Meilisearch; returns the decoded JSON body (`array()` for an empty body), whatever the HTTP status.
  - `protected function index_documents( string $uid ): array` — `GET /indexes/{uid}/documents?limit=1000` → `results`.
  - `protected static function test_host(): string` / `protected static function test_key(): string`.
  - `tear_down()` deletes every index whose uid starts with `{$prefix}_` and the plugin-created search key (uid read from `meilisearch_connection['search_key_uid']`).
- Environment variables: `MEILISEARCH_TEST_HOST` (default `http://127.0.0.1:7700`), `MEILISEARCH_TEST_KEY` (default `masterKey`), `MEILISEARCH_TEST_WC=1` (load WooCommerce), `WP_TESTS_DB_HOST` / `WP_TESTS_DB_NAME` / `WP_TESTS_DB_USER` / `WP_TESTS_DB_PASSWORD` (defaults `127.0.0.1` / `wordpress_test` / `wp` / `wp`). On OrbStack you may instead point them at `http://meilisearch.meilisearch-wordpress.orb.local:7700` and `db.meilisearch-wordpress.orb.local`; the defaults use the published ports so CI works unchanged.

Notes for the implementer:
- `Options` does not exist until Task 5, so `TestCase::set_up()` writes the plugin options with `update_option()` using the option names and keys from the catalog: `meilisearch_connection` (`host`, `prefix`, `search_key`, `search_key_uid`, `delete_on_uninstall`), `meilisearch_admin_key` (string), `meilisearch_content` (`post_types`, `taxonomies`, `meta_keys`). Every write happens inside the test's database transaction and is rolled back by `WP_UnitTestCase`.
- `woocommerce/action-scheduler` has Composer type `wordpress-plugin`. The first `installer-paths` entry pins it to `vendor/woocommerce/action-scheduler/` so `composer/installers` does not move it next to WooCommerce; order matters (first match wins).
- `WP_PLUGIN_DIR` is set to `tests/integration/plugins`, where Composer installs WooCommerce, so WooCommerce runs from a normal plugin directory. The Meilisearch plugin itself is loaded from the repository root.
- The async request runner of Action Scheduler is disabled in tests (`action_scheduler_allow_async_request_runner` → false); tests execute actions only through `run_actions()`.

```php
<?php
/**
 * WordPress test-suite configuration (loaded by wp-phpunit through WP_PHPUNIT__TESTS_CONFIG).
 *
 * @package Meilisearch
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

if ( ! function_exists( 'meilisearch_tests_env' ) ) {
	/**
	 * Reads an environment variable with a default.
	 *
	 * @param string $name          Variable name.
	 * @param string $default_value Value when unset or empty.
	 */
	function meilisearch_tests_env( string $name, string $default_value ): string {
		$value = getenv( $name );
		return ( false === $value || '' === $value ) ? $default_value : $value;
	}
}

define( 'ABSPATH', dirname( __DIR__, 2 ) . '/wordpress/' );
define( 'WP_PLUGIN_DIR', __DIR__ . '/plugins' );
define( 'WP_DEFAULT_THEME', 'default' );
```

Create `tests/integration/TestCase.php`:

```php
<?php
/**
 * Base class for integration tests (real WordPress, real Meilisearch).
 *
 * @package Meilisearch
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Integration;

use ActionScheduler;
use ActionScheduler_Store;
use WP_UnitTestCase;

abstract class TestCase extends WP_UnitTestCase {

	/**
	 * Index prefix of the current test: test_ + 6 lowercase alphanumerics.
	 *
	 * @var string
	 */
	protected string $prefix = '';

	/**
	 * "{hook}: {message}" for each action that failed during the last run_actions().
	 *
	 * @var list<string>
	 */
	protected array $action_failures = [];

	public function set_up(): void {
		parent::set_up();

		$this->prefix          = 'test_' . strtolower( wp_generate_password( 6, false, false ) );
		$this->action_failures = [];

		// Option names and keys from the catalog (Settings\Options arrives in Task 5).
		update_option(
			'meilisearch_connection',
			[
				'host'                => self::test_host(),
				'prefix'              => $this->prefix,
				'search_key'          => '',
				'search_key_uid'      => '',
				'delete_on_uninstall' => false,
			],
			false
		);
		update_option( 'meilisearch_admin_key', self::test_key(), false );
		update_option(
			'meilisearch_content',
			[
				'post_types' => [ 'post', 'page' ],
				'taxonomies' => [ 'post' => [ 'category', 'post_tag' ] ],
				'meta_keys'  => [],
			]
		);
	}

	public function tear_down(): void {
		if ( '' !== $this->prefix ) {
			$connection = get_option( 'meilisearch_connection', [] );
			$key_uid    = is_array( $connection ) && ! empty( $connection['search_key_uid'] ) ? (string) $connection['search_key_uid'] : '';
			if ( '' !== $key_uid ) {
				$this->meili( 'DELETE', '/keys/' . rawurlencode( $key_uid ) );
			}
			$indexes = $this->meili( 'GET', '/indexes?limit=1000' );
			foreach ( $indexes['results'] ?? [] as $index ) {
				$uid = (string) ( $index['uid'] ?? '' );
				if ( str_starts_with( $uid, $this->prefix . '_' ) ) {
					$this->meili( 'DELETE', '/indexes/' . rawurlencode( $uid ) );
				}
			}
		}
		parent::tear_down();
	}

	protected static function test_host(): string {
		$host = getenv( 'MEILISEARCH_TEST_HOST' );
		return ( false === $host || '' === $host ) ? 'http://127.0.0.1:7700' : rtrim( $host, '/' );
	}

	protected static function test_key(): string {
		$key = getenv( 'MEILISEARCH_TEST_KEY' );
		return ( false === $key || '' === $key ) ? 'masterKey' : $key;
	}

	/**
	 * Executes every pending action of group "meilisearch", whatever its scheduled date.
	 *
	 * @param int $max_rounds Maximum passes (handlers may schedule follow-up actions).
	 * @return int Number of actions executed.
	 */
	protected function run_actions( int $max_rounds = 20 ): int {
		$this->action_failures = [];
		$listener              = function ( $action_id, $exception ): void {
			$action                  = ActionScheduler::store()->fetch_action( (string) $action_id );
			$this->action_failures[] = $action->get_hook() . ': ' . $exception->getMessage();
		};
		add_action( 'action_scheduler_failed_execution', $listener, 10, 2 );

		$executed = 0;
		for ( $round = 0; $round < $max_rounds; $round++ ) {
			$ids = as_get_scheduled_actions(
				[
					'group'    => 'meilisearch',
					'status'   => ActionScheduler_Store::STATUS_PENDING,
					'per_page' => -1,
					'orderby'  => 'date',
					'order'    => 'ASC',
				],
				'ids'
			);
			if ( [] === $ids ) {
				break;
			}
			foreach ( $ids as $id ) {
				ActionScheduler::runner()->process_action( (int) $id, 'meilisearch-tests' );
				++$executed;
			}
		}

		remove_action( 'action_scheduler_failed_execution', $listener, 10 );
		return $executed;
	}

	/**
	 * Waits until Meilisearch has no enqueued or processing task (30 s max).
	 */
	protected function wait_for_tasks(): void {
		$deadline = microtime( true ) + 30.0;
		do {
			$pending = $this->meili( 'GET', '/tasks?statuses=enqueued,processing&limit=1' );
			if ( empty( $pending['results'] ) ) {
				return;
			}
			usleep( 100000 );
		} while ( microtime( true ) < $deadline );

		$this->fail( 'Meilisearch tasks were still pending after 30 seconds.' );
	}

	/**
	 * Sends a raw request to the test Meilisearch.
	 *
	 * @param string                  $method HTTP method.
	 * @param string                  $path   Path with query string, starting with '/'.
	 * @param array<int|string, mixed>|null $body JSON body.
	 * @return array<int|string, mixed> Decoded body, array() when empty, whatever the status.
	 */
	protected function meili( string $method, string $path, ?array $body = null ): array {
		$args = [
			'method'  => $method,
			'timeout' => 30,
			'headers' => [
				'Authorization' => 'Bearer ' . self::test_key(),
				'Content-Type'  => 'application/json',
			],
		];
		if ( null !== $body ) {
			$args['body'] = wp_json_encode( $body );
		}

		$response = wp_remote_request( self::test_host() . $path, $args );
		if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
			$this->fail( 'Meilisearch request failed: ' . $response->get_error_message() );
		}

		$decoded = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response ), true );
		return is_array( $decoded ) ? $decoded : [];
	}

	/**
	 * Returns up to 1000 documents of an index.
	 *
	 * @param string $uid Index uid.
	 * @return list<array<string, mixed>>
	 */
	protected function index_documents( string $uid ): array {
		return $this->meili( 'GET', '/indexes/' . rawurlencode( $uid ) . '/documents?limit=1000' )['results'] ?? [];
	}
}
```

### Task 3: HTTP transport, `Response`, `ApiError`, `Client` request core, `FakeTransport`

**Files:**
- Create: `src/Api/Response.php`, `src/Api/Transport.php`, `src/Api/WpTransport.php`, `src/Api/ApiError.php`, `src/Api/Client.php`
- Create: `tests/unit/Support/FakeTransport.php`
- Test: `tests/unit/Api/ClientTest.php`, `tests/unit/Api/ApiErrorTest.php`, `tests/unit/Api/WpTransportTest.php`, `tests/unit/Support/FakeTransportTest.php`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Tests\Unit\TestCase` (Task 1); WordPress `wp_remote_request( $url, $args )`, `is_wp_error()`, `wp_remote_retrieve_response_code()`, `wp_remote_retrieve_body()`, `wp_json_encode()`.
- Produces (catalog):
  - `final class Response { public function __construct( public readonly int $status, public readonly ?array $body, public readonly string $raw ) {} }`
  - `interface Transport { public function send( string $method, string $url, array $headers, ?string $body, float $timeout ): Response; }`
  - `final class WpTransport implements Transport {}`
  - `final class ApiError extends \RuntimeException { public function __construct( string $message, public readonly string $error_code, public readonly int $http_status = 0, ?\Throwable $previous = null ); public static function from_response( Response $response ): self; public static function transport( string $message ): self; }`
  - `final class Client { public const SEARCH_TIMEOUT = 2.0; public const WRITE_TIMEOUT = 15.0; public function __construct( Transport $transport, string $host, string $api_key, string $user_agent ); public function version(): array; }` — the other endpoint methods arrive in Task 4. This task implements the private request core and `version()`, and tests the core through `version()`.
  - Test support `Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit\Support\FakeTransport implements Transport`:
    - `respond( int $status, ?array $body = null ): self` — queues a response; `raw` is `json_encode( $body )` (`''` when null).
    - `respond_raw( int $status, string $raw ): self` — queues a response with a raw body (decoded when it is JSON, else `body` null).
    - `fail( \Throwable $error ): self` — queues an exception thrown by the next `send()`.
    - `queue( Response|\Throwable $next ): self` — queues a prepared `Response` or an exception (what `respond()`/`fail()` use internally).
    - `requests(): array` — returns `$requests`.
    - `public array $requests` — `list<array{method: string, url: string, headers: array<string,string>, body: mixed, raw_body: ?string, timeout: float}>`; `body` is the JSON-decoded request body (null without body).
    - `last(): array` — the last recorded request; `pending(): int` — queued responses not yet consumed.
    - `send()` with an empty queue throws `\LogicException( 'FakeTransport: no response queued for {METHOD} {url}.' )`.

Behaviour decisions (used by every later task):
- `Client` strips trailing `/` from the host and appends the path verbatim, so a reverse-proxy prefix (`https://example.com/meili`) is kept in every URL.
- Headers: `Content-Type: application/json`, `User-Agent: {user agent}`, and `Authorization: Bearer {key}` only when the key is not empty.
- JSON bodies are encoded with `JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_PRESERVE_ZERO_FRACTION`; an unencodable body throws `ApiError` code `encode_error` before any request is sent.
- Any status outside 200–299 throws `ApiError::from_response()`: `error_code` = body `code` (else `http_{status}`), message = body `message` (else "Meilisearch returned an unexpected HTTP {status} response."), `http_status` = status, `getCode()` = status.
- 200, 202 and 204 are all success; a 204 or non-JSON body gives `Response::$body === null` and `version()` returns `array()`.
- Network failures and timeouts surface as `ApiError` code `transport_error`, `http_status` 0; redirects are not followed (`redirection` 0).

- [ ] **Step 1: Create the fake transport**

Create `tests/unit/Support/FakeTransport.php`:

```php
<?php
/**
 * Scripted Transport for unit tests.
 *
 * @package Meilisearch
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit\Support;

use Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\Response;
use Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\Transport;

final class FakeTransport implements Transport {

	/**
	 * Recorded requests, oldest first.
	 *
	 * @var list<array{method: string, url: string, headers: array<string, string>, body: mixed, raw_body: ?string, timeout: float}>
	 */
	public array $requests = [];

	/**
	 * Queued responses and exceptions.
	 *
	 * @var list<Response|\Throwable>
	 */
	private array $queue = [];

	public function queue( Response|\Throwable $next ): self {
		$this->queue[] = $next;
		return $this;
	}

	public function respond( int $status, ?array $body = null ): self {
		return $this->queue( new Response( $status, $body, null === $body ? '' : (string) json_encode( $body ) ) );
	}

	public function respond_raw( int $status, string $raw ): self {
		$decoded = json_decode( $raw, true );
		return $this->queue( new Response( $status, is_array( $decoded ) ? $decoded : null, $raw ) );
	}

	public function fail( \Throwable $error ): self {
		return $this->queue( $error );
	}

	public function requests(): array {
		return $this->requests;
	}

	public function send( string $method, string $url, array $headers, ?string $body, float $timeout ): Response {
		$this->requests[] = [
			'method'   => $method,
			'url'      => $url,
			'headers'  => $headers,
			'body'     => null === $body ? null : json_decode( $body, true ),
			'raw_body' => $body,
			'timeout'  => $timeout,
		];

		if ( [] === $this->queue ) {
			throw new \LogicException( sprintf( 'FakeTransport: no response queued for %s %s.', $method, $url ) );
		}

		$next = array_shift( $this->queue );
		if ( $next instanceof \Throwable ) {
			throw $next;
		}
		return $next;
	}

	public function last(): array {
		if ( [] === $this->requests ) {
			throw new \LogicException( 'FakeTransport: no request was sent.' );
		}
		return $this->requests[ count( $this->requests ) - 1 ];
	}

	public function pending(): int {
		return count( $this->queue );
	}
}
```

```php
<?php
/**
 * Pins the FakeTransport API other tests rely on.
 *
 * @package Meilisearch
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit\Support;

use Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\ApiError;
use Meilisearch\WordPress\Api\Response;
use Meilisearch\WordPress\Tests\Unit\TestCase;

final class FakeTransportTest extends TestCase {

	public function test_queue_returns_responses_and_throws_errors_in_order(): void {
		$response  = new Response( 200, [ 'ok' => true ], '{"ok":true}' );
		$error     = ApiError::transport( 'down' );
		$transport = ( new FakeTransport() )->queue( $response )->queue( $error );

		$this->assertSame( 2, $transport->pending() );
		$this->assertSame( $response, $transport->send( 'GET', 'http://ms.test/a', [], null, 2.0 ) );

		try {
			$transport->send( 'POST', 'http://ms.test/b', [ 'X' => '1' ], '{"q":"x"}', 15.0 );
			$this->fail( 'The queued error was not thrown.' );
		} catch ( ApiError $thrown ) {
			$this->assertSame( $error, $thrown );
		}
		$this->assertSame( 0, $transport->pending() );
	}

	public function test_requests_records_every_call(): void {
		$transport = ( new FakeTransport() )->respond( 204 )->respond( 200, [] );
		$transport->send( 'DELETE', 'http://ms.test/keys/k', [], null, 15.0 );
		$transport->send( 'POST', 'http://ms.test/search', [ 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' ], '{"q":"x"}', 2.0 );

		$this->assertSame(
			[
				[
					'method'   => 'DELETE',
					'url'      => 'http://ms.test/keys/k',
					'headers'  => [],
					'body'     => null,
					'raw_body' => null,
					'timeout'  => 15.0,
				],
				[
					'method'   => 'POST',
					'url'      => 'http://ms.test/search',
					'headers'  => [ 'Content-Type' => 'application/json' ],
					'body'     => [ 'q' => 'x' ],
					'raw_body' => '{"q":"x"}',
					'timeout'  => 2.0,
				],
			],
			$transport->requests()
		);
		$this->assertSame( $transport->requests, $transport->requests() );
		$this->assertSame( 'POST', $transport->last()['method'] );
	}

	public function test_empty_queue_throws(): void {
		$this->expectException( \LogicException::class );
		$this->expectExceptionMessage( 'FakeTransport: no response queued for GET http://ms.test/version.' );

		( new FakeTransport() )->send( 'GET', 'http://ms.test/version', [], null, 2.0 );
	}
}
```
